answer: Cohort-bonded activation: every new account locks 3 POA for 25 epochs, and each funding wallet may activate one account per 2 epochs. An honest user pays 3 POA once and waits at most 2 epochs, while 1,000 fakes from one wallet need 3,000 POA locked and 2,000 epochs of queue, a slow spiral. Splitting funds across wallets removes the queue but not the bond, so the total stays 3,000 POA. Jurors test a random 5% for a live signal, such as a typed reply within two minutes; a miss forfeits 50% of the lock. A rich attacker can still pay, but each terrace of capital costs linearly.
